Forgot your password?

Coral has no email to send a link to. Resetting happens on the computer that runs Coral, which keeps it safe from anyone else on the network.

  1. Open a terminal on this computer (the one running Coral).
  2. Run:
coral reset-password
  1. Choose a new password when it asks. Browsers that were signed in are signed out.
  2. Come back here and sign in.

The Coral app and the tray open without a password.

Link this computer to Coral Hub

Link it once, then sign in here with your Coral Hub account instead of a password. You will finish in Coral Hub and come back here.

⚠Coral Hub can then sign you in here with full control of this computer. A Coral Hub account that is signed in can run commands on this computer, like your password can.

Finish in Coral Hub

Coral Hub is open in a new tab. Check that it shows this code, then approve linking this computer.

Waiting for you to approve in Coral Hub…

Nothing is linked until you approve. This page signs you in by itself when you do.

Use an API key

Paste the key from Settings in the Coral app, or from the file ~/.coral/api_key on the computer that runs Coral.
